settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.management_description: Upload plugins, add bot accounts (clients) and create plugin instances in the maubot management UI. Log in with the user and password below.
settings.homeservers_description: Matrix homeservers whose bot accounts can be logged in from the management UI with a password. Bots on other homeservers can still be added with an access token. With the registration shared secret of a Synapse homeserver, new bot accounts can be registered from the UI.
settings.invalid_server_name: Must be a Matrix server name, like example.org or example.org:8448
settings.duplicate_server_name: This server name is already in the list
settings.invalid_homeserver_url: Must be an http:// or https:// URL, like https://matrix.example.org
settings.new_admin_password_helper: Leave empty to keep the current password.
settings.admin_password_maxLength: Must be at most 256 characters long
